zh.summary: 結論：資安不只是「不讓別人偷看」，還要防止資料被不當更動，並讓有權使用的人在需要時能用。

sourceBody.text: 今天早間的新路線第一個概念：CIA 三要素。
1. 白話定義

items: 機密性 Confidentiality：只有獲授權的人能取得資訊。
完整性 Integrity：資訊不被不當修改或破壞。
可用性 Availability：需要時能及時、可靠地存取資訊與服務。

sourceBody.text: 2. 用途與條件
評估一個系統時，先問「保護什麼、誰有權使用、什麼時候必須能用」，才選控制措施。三者的重要程度要依業務情境決定，不是所有系統都平均分配。
3. 一個連貫例子
虛構的 Northstar 教材平台：陌生人讀到學生的私人作答，是機密性問題；分數被未授權改動，是完整性問題；考試時系統停擺，是可用性問題。同一事件可能同時損害多項，例如勒索軟體可能讓資料無法使用，也可能先竊走資料。

visual.caption: 網頁補充：Northstar 的三種保護目標
visual.description: 三者是並列目標；同一事件可能影響多項。

sourceBody.text: 4. 防護與證據判讀
權限控管與加密可協助保護機密性；變更審核、可信的雜湊比對或數位簽章可協助檢查完整性；備援、容量規劃及實際還原測試可協助維持可用性。
但「有 HTTPS」不能證明授權正確；「有備份」不能證明還原得回來；雜湊相同也不能證明原始資料本來就正確。控制措施與驗證證據要分開看。
5. 小檢核
某份成績檔沒有外洩、內容也沒被更改，但老師在繳交截止前完全打不開。主要受影響的是哪個要素？你會找什麼證據確認？
參考：[NIST 機密性](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/confidentiality)、[完整性](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/integrity)、[可用性](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/availability)。

en.summary: Conclusion: security is more than preventing others from reading information. It also prevents improper changes and lets authorized people use information when they need it.

sourceBody.text: The first concept in the new morning route: the CIA triad.
1. Plain-language definitions

items: Confidentiality: only authorized people can obtain the information.
Integrity: information is not improperly modified or destroyed.
Availability: information and services can be accessed in a timely, reliable way when needed.

sourceBody.text: 2. Uses and conditions

When assessing a system, first ask what needs protection, who may use it, and when it must be available. Then choose controls. The relative importance of the three goals depends on the business context; equal weighting is not appropriate for every system.
3. One connected example

In the fictional Northstar learning platform, a stranger reading students' private answers is a confidentiality problem; unauthorized grade changes are an integrity problem; an outage during an exam is an availability problem. One incident can harm several goals: ransomware may make data unavailable and may also steal it first.

visual.caption: Web supplement: three protection goals at Northstar
visual.description: Parallel goals: one incident may affect several.

sourceBody.text: 4. Defenses and evidence

Access control and encryption can help protect confidentiality. Change review, comparison against trusted hashes, or digital signatures can help check integrity. Redundancy, capacity planning, and actual restoration tests can help maintain availability.

But HTTPS does not prove that authorization is correct. Having a backup does not prove that restoration will work. Matching hashes do not establish that the original data was correct. Keep controls and verification evidence separate.
5. Quick check
A grade file has not leaked or been changed, but the teacher cannot open it at all before the submission deadline. Which goal is primarily affected? What evidence would you seek to confirm this?

References: [NIST confidentiality](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/confidentiality), [integrity](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/integrity), and [availability](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/availability).
